moments.author: Aaron Donald
moments.quote: I’ve been working the last 12‑13 weeks ... I am now ready to come back to try and do something special with this group of guys. We back.
moments.why: One of the NFL’s all‑time great defenders announced his return from retirement — a massive cultural moment for football, especially among men 25‑45.

moments.author: Houston Rockets (team)
moments.quote: OFFICIAL: The Houston Rockets today announced they have signed guard Amen Thompson to a contract extension.
moments.why: Amen Thompson locked in a huge five‑year, $208 million deal — a key NBA moment that’s sparking buzz among sports fans and fantasy leagues.

moments.author: Shams Charania
moments.quote: Just in: Houston Rockets' Amen Thompson has agreed to a five‑year, $208 million rookie‑scale contract extension ... The new deal includes a 10% trade kicker.
moments.why: The ESPN insider tweet about Thompson’s extension lit up X, driving major engagement among NBA and adult male audiences.

moments.author: Los Angeles Rams
moments.quote: Aaron Donald unretires, will play for Rams in 2026
moments.why: The team tweet confirming Donald’s return fueled renewed optimism and intensity around a Super Bowl‑contending defense.
